Authentication._comment: Same IdP configuration as the gateway (ADR-0006): Keycloak locally, Entra ID in Azure. RequireHttpsMetadata is not set here; it defaults to true/false based on whether Authority itself starts with https://.

Authorization._comment: Step 0.6 turns this on once a real IPermissionChecker backed by access.has_permission exists.

Database._comment: Role svc_platform (conventions-backend.md §9). The password is never here: set Nexus__Database__Password (env var) or 'dotnet user-secrets set Nexus:Database:Password ...'. Local value: NEXUS_SVC_PLATFORM_PASSWORD in infra/compose/.env.
